chronicle.title: Bartholomeu Krauser: guided creation to the 2010 threshold
chronicle.dramatic_engine: A mortal craftsman tries to keep responsibility, family, and self-determination under pressure from hidden systems; after an imposed transformation, survival and status demand compromises whose costs remain his to choose.
chronicle.genre: Personal horror with gothic-punk social pressure, human-scale family stakes, industrial atmosphere, and Cainite political conflict.
design_principles: Consequences travel through observable actions and named channels.
Silence, refusal, flight, failure, and abandonment close local units without being punished by an infinite hook chain.
NPCs pursue independent goals on their own clocks; no NPC knows untransmitted information.
A forced Embrace is a future authorial target, never a reward or an already-played outcome.
No story grants XP, dots, damage, Hunger, Humanity, or state changes automatically.
chronicle.play_preparation: D07 V014 truth contracts and D08 V014 scene preparation are authored; current validation and adversarial review remain pending. C06 is unstarted and operationally gated.

causality_policy.family_boundary: No NPC may know family identity/location/response unless a recorded source or future observed event supplies that exact fact. The prepared threat at confrontation is generic unless a valid source exists.
causality_policy.variant_boundary: D12 V001 is used literally; no preexisting details of Mary’s knowledge are added.
causality_policy.box_boundary: C05 box contents remain UNKNOWN and are not required by the route.

finite_progression.scene_queue: Each story has a local closure and a no-contact/abandonment exit. The player can end guided creation at the 2010 review with COMPLETE, ALTERNATE or INCOMPLETE evidence; no infinite provocations.
finite_progression.target_window: Authorial target: forced Embrace after the played C05 checkpoint and before 1970-12-25, only after actual M3.01 closure and an authorized, recorded transition; no exact date. If infeasible on the played timeline, retain an alternate/incomplete outcome.

episode_closure_gate.purpose: Permit a future M3.02 only after the played M3.01 has a finite, player-confirmed and source-reconciled close; this does not close M3.01 now.
required_evidence: For the target route, the required ST-C06-REENTRY has actually started and has a recorded outcome, explicit local closure evidence, and reconciled persistence. C06 not started, declined, or abandoned cannot be treated as a vacuous satisfied requirement.
Every required story unit actually started in M3.01 has a recorded local outcome and closure evidence; no required unit is left silently open.
Every optional M3.01 story that was started has an outcome; every unstarted optional story is explicitly left quiet/declined rather than treated as mandatory.
The player explicitly chooses to close M3.01 after reviewing the actual timeline and outcome; no closure is inferred from C06 labels or elapsed time.
The latest episode source, LIVE, HISTORY_INDEX and character state reconcile at the same event boundary; relevant blob hashes and pending persistence reconcile.

A new highest-numbered CYCLE valid under the current orchestration contract records the authorized transition and next role. Use only fields/statuses supported by that contract; if it has no supported closure/transition representation, stop and keep M3.02 blocked until an authorized contract successor exists.
denial_conditions: C06/ST-C06-REENTRY has no played, recorded closure. A player-declared decline/abandonment may close only as alternate/incomplete and does not authorize M3.02.
Any required unit remains open without a player-declared alternate/abandonment disposition.
Timeline/source state conflict or unresolved persistence.
Cycle contract lacks a supported transition record or the highest valid cycle does not reflect it.
episode_closure_gate.result: Only after every required target-route item, including played C06, has the evidence above may the player confirm M3.01 closure and an authorized cycle record a separate M3.02 transition. If C06 is declined or left unplayed, the finite result is alternate/incomplete and M3.02 stays blocked. Narrator use still requires its own cycle, SCENE_READY and permission gates.
